verdict.rationale: Gitleaks documents a configuration format (gitleaks.toml) for writing custom detection rules, including composite primary/required rules and per-rule allowlists. These rules are limited to secret detection rather than general static analysis. Sharing is only implied: GITLEAKS_CONFIG can point to a config path, or a gitleaks.toml at the repo root is auto-detected, but no cross-repo rule-sharing mechanism is documented. Missing for 10: general-purpose SAST rule support beyond secret patterns, a documented mechanism for sharing or extending rule sets across repositories, independent corroboration of rule-authoring simplicity.
